verses.text: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
lines: Hear this, all you peoples.
Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

verses.text: both low and high, rich and poor together.
lines: both low and high,
rich and poor together.

verses.text: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
lines: My mouth will speak words of wisdom.
My heart will utter understanding.

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
lines: I will incline my ear to a proverb.
I will solve my riddle on the harp.

verses.text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
lines: Why should I fear in the days of evil,
when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

verses.text: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
lines: Those who trust in their wealth,
and boast in the multitude of their riches—

verses.text: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
lines: none of them can by any means redeem his brother,
nor give God a ransom for him.

verses.text: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
lines: For the redemption of their life is costly,
no payment is ever enough,

verses.text: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
lines: that he should live on forever,
that he should not see corruption.

verses.text: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
lines: For he sees that wise men die;
likewise the fool and the senseless perish,
and leave their wealth to others.

verses.text: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
lines: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever,
and their dwelling places to all generations.
They name their lands after themselves.

verses.text: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
lines: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure.
He is like the animals that perish.

verses.text: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings.
lines: This is the destiny of those who are foolish,
and of those who approve their sayings.

verses.text: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
lines: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol.
Death shall be their shepherd.
The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning.
Their beauty shall decay in Sheol,
far from their mansion.

verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
lines: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol,
for he will receive me.

verses.text: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
lines: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich,
when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.text: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
lines: for when he dies he will carry nothing away.
His glory won’t descend after him.

verses.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
lines: Though while he lived he blessed his soul—
and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

verses.text: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
lines: he shall go to the generation of his fathers.
They shall never see the light.

verses.text: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
lines: A man who has riches without understanding,
is like the animals that perish.
